purpose: Runtime import for the encounter checker. This is not a creature browser and contains no raw SRD stat-block text.

damage.recharge: (maximum - minimum + 1) / 6 after the feature has been spent
action_economy: Choose one Action or Magic action per turn unless the stat block explicitly combines them.
A Bonus Action, Reaction, Legendary Action, and Lair Action use their own printed budget; none consumes or creates a normal Action unless the text says so.
Recharge controls availability only. Read activation_type from the section heading, never from the word Recharge.
A rechargeable Action replaces the routine Action; a rechargeable Bonus Action uses only the Bonus Action budget.
Schedule shared spell slots, N/Day Each, recharge, concentration, and once-per-turn riders before selecting the round's legal feature set.

interpretation.principle: Read the entered creature first. Its printed attack bonus, DC, damage dice, target wording, resource limit, and action section are the source of the combat calculation.
interpretation.named_spell_resolution: If a feature names a recognized spell and omits or abbreviates its mechanics, resolve the spell at the printed cast level from the versioned spell profile. A printed damage expression always wins.
interpretation.unknown_feature_policy: Never silently replace an unknown action or spell with a CR/tier DPR estimate. Mark it NEEDS DM INPUT or ESTIMATED and keep the uncertainty in the trace.
interpretation.trace_requirement: Every round reports each scheduled feature, activation channel, resource spent, hit/save expectation, target count, expected damage, and unresolved assumption.

sustain.effective_hp_rule: (raw_hp + explicit_same_encounter_pools) * ac_multiplier * PRODUCT(distinct_trait_multipliers) / damage_pass_fraction / damage_uptime * party_size_hp_multiplier
sustain.regression_evidence: 600/600 retained samples from the 80,000-case calibration reproduce exactly under the multiplicative rule.
sustain.anti_double_count: An effect entered as explicit healing, restore, prevention, damage pass, or uptime must not also receive its trait multiplier.

trait_rules.label: Relevant save / ABS -1 vs CR expectation [conditional]
Relevant save / ABS -2 vs CR expectation [conditional]
Relevant save / ABS -3 vs CR expectation [conditional]
Reactive resistance to last damage type
First attack each round at disadvantage
Concealment until first attack hits each round
Damage absorption / healing conversion
trait_rules.guidance: Explicit absorbed damage becomes healing; no fixed coefficient.

trait_rules.label: Damage transfer / redirection
trait_rules.guidance: Move damage to the linked body's own EHP pool; do not create HP.

trait_rules.label: Multiple forms / replacement body
trait_rules.guidance: Add only the HP pool that can occur in the same encounter.

trait_rules.label: Once-per-round damage halving
trait_rules.guidance: Expected prevented damage, limited to one legal Reaction.

trait_rules.label: Parry / reaction AC
trait_rules.guidance: Price only the expected attack affected; consumes the Reaction.

trait_rules.label: Limited spell immunity
trait_rules.guidance: Apply against the party's actual spell-tier damage share.

trait_rules.label: Spell reflection / turning
trait_rules.guidance: Prevention is sustain; reflected damage is separate DPR.

trait_rules.label: Conditional regeneration with shutoff
trait_rules.guidance: Use active rounds after applying the shutoff damage profile.

trait_rules.label: Damage threshold
trait_rules.guidance: Model per-hit distribution; never convert directly to flat HP.

trait_rules.label: Possession / body replacement
trait_rules.guidance: Use host/replacement pool only when legally available in-fight.

trait_rules.label: Shared HP / linked bodies
trait_rules.guidance: Use one shared pool and separate action bodies; do not multiply the pool.

trait_rules.label: Lair-action defense
trait_rules.guidance: Apply only while the lair condition is active.

trait_rules.label: Untargetable / unreachable windows
trait_rules.guidance: Represent through party damage uptime, not raw HP.

trait_rules.label: Condition immunity
trait_rules.guidance: Protects action uptime; no generic HP credit without a party control profile.

trait_rules.label: Rejuvenation after the encounter
trait_rules.guidance: Does not increase EHP in the current encounter.

trait_rules.label: Temporary HP
trait_rules.guidance: Add explicit available pool once; do not also use a trait multiplier.

trait_rules.label: Save reroll / inspiration
trait_rules.guidance: Apply to the affected save event, not every incoming attack.

trait_rules.label: Control that removes enemy actions
trait_rules.guidance: Reduce monster action uptime; do not add player HP.

survivor_projection.focus_fire: Equal per-PC sustain with sequential damage packing; projects the greatest number of individual downs for a given damage total.
survivor_projection.spread_evenly: Equal per-PC sustain with even damage allocation; all standing PCs are projected damaged until total party sustain is exhausted.
survivor_projection.precision: Downs, damaged-but-standing, and standing counts are model projections under the selected allocation, not observed combat outcomes.

parser.source_of_truth: Entered action text and numeric fields; do not use CR-band damage for identified actions.
parser.unknown_policy: NEEDS DM INPUT or ESTIMATED with trace; never silently use a lower spell tier or CR band.

equipmentModes.wotcStandard: No automatic combat bonus from unspecified magic items.
equipmentModes.brokenChain: Campaign gear overlay included; selected Convergence remains a separate encounter input.

provenance.statistic: weighted median using the workbook sample weights

effect_families.guidance: Apply the AC change only to eligible attacks and only while the reaction or duration is available.
Recalculate hit probability for the affected attacks; do not use a flat HP bonus.
Weight by the selected party's actual damage-type share and bypass rules.
Resolve against individual hits or per-round damage before summing; never convert blindly to flat HP.
Prevent eligible damage and add only explicitly granted healing; retain the damage-type trigger.
Track timing, uses, shutoff conditions, healing caps, and whether the pool can occur in this encounter.
Track the save, HP restored, uses, delay, and shutoff. Post-encounter rejuvenation gives no current-fight EHP.
Move damage between existing bodies or one shared pool; never duplicate the same HP.
Add only forms that legally appear in the same fight, with trigger and carry-over rules.
Model targetability, advantage/disadvantage, and reveal conditions rather than a permanent HP multiplier.
Change each side's reachable-target fraction only when terrain and ranges make the movement relevant.
Protect action uptime against matching party effects; give no universal EHP credit without that profile.
Spend uses against the most valuable failed saves and preserve the exact number of uses.
Follow the printed sequence and alternatives; do not add every listed attack together.
Keep recharge probability separate from activation type; a recharge Action replaces the routine Action.
Add only separately legal actions, honoring costs, triggers, uses, and initiative timing.
Multiply expected per-target damage by exposed targets and active rounds, respecting repeat saves and exits.
Use expected eligible triggers; death effects occur once and reflected damage remains separate from prevented damage.
Recalculate hit and rider probability from the chance the positional or target condition is met.
Use the stat block's own spells, uses, and slots. Actual spell text overrides tier fallback values.
Prevent or redirect eligible spell events using range, reaction, check, tier, and use constraints.
Track escape actions, save recurrence, movement/range impact, and resulting advantage rather than inventing damage.
Convert failed-save duration into expected lost actions and any attack/save consequences.
Track the altered pool or disabled recovery separately from immediate damage and reset it at the stated cadence.
Report fatal/down probability and trigger round; never disguise the effect as ordinary DPR.
Add each created body as a timed roster entry with its own HP, actions, duration, and initiative.
Switch offense, defenses, size, or traits at the printed HP/state threshold.
Enable only when the encounter location and initiative procedure satisfy the requirement.

A2-05.maximum_rule: min(eligible original bodies, surviving distinct raiser opportunities); husks cannot raise or be raised recursively
A2-05.anti_double_count: The stale 1.30 abstract revival factor is removed from the three full-form library multipliers; use explicit Frozen Husk children only.

events.timing: next legal whole Action of a surviving Frozen Sentinel or Frost-Weaver
events.automatic_scheduler_policy: use at the first legal action when an eligible once-only body exists

events.timing: start of the full-form Rime Wight's turn
events.automatic_scheduler_policy: use at the first legal start of turn when an eligible body exists

A2-07.anti_double_count: The Wight's precomputed sustain multiplier already includes its personal return, Bone Armor, and regeneration. Do not add restore EHP again in an aggregate-profile simulation; the spawned Lesser remains a separate body.

events.timing: immediately after the triggering damage resolves
state_changes: end grapple and throw target prone
Hungering Leap recharges and is used to reach the bone pile

spawn.initiative: roll immediately; act this round if that count has not passed, otherwise next round

campaign_semantics.whole_body_attrition: A living creature retains its full legal output until its body reaches 0 HP. Do not linearly reduce a singleton's DPR as its HP is chipped.
campaign_semantics.final_round: Use a single initiative model; never apply an extra completion-round damage discount on top of midpoint/whole-body attrition.

source_policy.bundled: compact rule/effect/spell data and private campaign profiles
source_policy.local_input: owned non-SRD WotC or homebrew stat blocks are parsed locally and are not redistributed
source_policy.excluded: raw SRD monster prose, non-SRD creature text, and unlicensed third-party creature data
